feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: How a pizza app changed our relationship with waiting
entry.summary: Status trackers are ubiquitous on online apps and ordering. We have the story the seminal Domino's Pizza Tracker that led to many copies, and we check on why many of the trackers now aren't accurate.

entry.title: Trump says he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
entry.summary: The president chalked the ban up to what he called unfavorable coverage, and he threatened that bans on other media companies could be coming.

entry.title: When Trump and Xi meet they will discuss AI. 'Track Two' talks are already buzzing
entry.summary: An informal network of dialogues at think tanks and universities is bringing together experts from the U.S. and China to talk about the shared perils of AI — and possible paths forward.

entry.title: What expensive sulfur means for your dinner table
entry.summary: Oil supplies are falling, sulfur prices are threatening food costs, and we measure Lego against Hollywood

entry.title: Ms. Rachel has entered her album era, and she is so happy about it
entry.summary: Ms. Rachel has conquered YouTube, Netflix and the toy aisle. Now she's making an album, with real instruments, big feelings and her littlest listeners in mind.

entry.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
entry.summary: Warren Buffett is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after serving in the role for more than 50 years. His son, Howard, will become Berkshire Hathaway's new chairman

entry.title: Could trees developed with gene-editing technology protect Florida's citrus industry?
entry.summary: A bacterial infection is wiping out Florida's citrus trees. Growers hope a rootstock developed with gene-editing technology could keep the disease at bay.

entry.title: A bad year for the crypto industry just got a lot worse
entry.summary: The cryptocurrency industry just suffered a major defeat in a bill they had badly wanted to get through the Senate. It's the latest setback in a terrible year for the sector.

entry.title: How Jared Kushner is mixing U.S. diplomacy with his billion-dollar business
entry.summary: The New Yorker's Dexter Filkins says while Trump's son-in-law is a U.S. special envoy negotiating peace, he's also working on private business deals, raising billions in some of the same countries.

entry.title: How are rising prices affecting you? NPR wants to know
entry.summary: Inflation, gasoline prices and the cost of living are top of mind in the election season. How are higher costs shaping the way you live? NPR wants to hear.
